files.description: Bike-share trips, 1 September to 1 November 2025 (1500 rows): trip_id (whole number), rider_id (refers to riders.csv), start_station and end_station (refer to station_code in stations.csv), started_at (timestamp written as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM), duration_min (whole minutes; about 3% empty), distance_km (two decimals), fare (two decimals; about 3% empty), payment (card, app or cash; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), rating (1-5 stars, whole number; about 19% empty).

task_text: Some trips have an empty duration_min. Fill each empty duration with the median duration of the other trips that started at the same station; if no trip from that station has a duration, leave it empty. `result` should be the full trips table with duration_min filled in.
intended_computation: Read trips.csv. For every trip with an empty duration_min, set duration_min to the median of the non-empty duration_min values of all trips with the same start_station; if that station has no non-empty duration, the value stays missing. All other columns and rows are unchanged; the result is the whole trips table (1500 rows).

acceptable_variants.notes: id columns (rider_id, station codes) may be written as integers without leading zeros; duration_min may be float; started_at may be text or a timestamp

notes: invited_ids_author labelled by hand after the intents were frozen (step A2); intent not rewritten for it.
